summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted with right-sided chest pain and found to have multifocal pneumonia and acute kidney injury. He had a history of relapsing polychondritis with a recently placed bronchial stent that developed proximal stenosis. Blood and respiratory cultures identified methicillin-susceptible Staphylococcus aureus, and he was treated with vancomycin and zosyn. Due to persistent stent narrowing and infection, he underwent bronchoscopy with stent removal and balloon dilation. A PICC line was placed for outpatient antibiotic therapy. His infection resolved, kidney function improved, and he was discharged home on IV antibiotics with follow-up in rheumatology and interventional pulmonology.
